page.content:
Sun-raising alicorn who rules Equestria and teaches Twilight Sparkle.

How Princess Celestia connects

  • Location: Equestria — Princess Celestia rules Equestria and raises the sun.
  • Location: Canterlot — Princess Celestia holds court in Canterlot.
  • Character: Twilight Sparkle — Celestia is Twilight Sparkle's teacher and later fellow princess.
  • Character: Sunset Shimmer — Sunset Shimmer was Celestia's student before fleeing through the mirror.

What is Princess Celestia?

Princess Celestia raises the sun, shares the throne with Princess Luna, and sends Twilight Sparkle to Ponyville so friendship — not only books — will finish her student's education.

Key threads lead to Equestria, Canterlot, Twilight Sparkle and Sunset Shimmer.
